title: Senior Backend Engineer
content: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Acme</strong></p><p>Acme builds workflow software for logistics teams in 40+ countries. We are a team of 350 people across New York, London and Berlin.</p></div><h3>The role</h3><p>We&rsquo;re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to own our shipment-tracking APIs (Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka).</p><h3>What you&#39;ll do</h3><ul><li>Design and operate high-throughput event pipelines</li><li>Mentor engineers &amp; lead technical design reviews</li></ul><h3>Location</h3><p>This is a fully remote role, but <strong>candidates must be located in the United States</strong> and able to work Eastern or Central time hours. We cannot hire outside the US at this time.</p><h3>Compensation</h3><p>The base salary range for this role is $150,000&ndash;$190,000 USD per year, plus equity.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Acme is an equal opportunity employer &amp; values diversity at our company.</p></div>
